outputNormalization: Only leading/trailing blank lines stripped; raw and normalized hashes retained.

negativeCheck.reason: A new assertion incorrectly expected a supplied RO controller BUSY25 bit to reject. Existing controller contract ignores that bit and completes the actual command with BUSY0. Assertion corrected; implementation semantics unchanged.

auditReceipt.scope: Read-only fixed source and typed disassembly audit; existing native run only read.

trm.note: O-CODE matches are the substring in pseudo-code, not calibration docs; I2C_ANA_MST mentions are LP map and LP_TEE controls.

actualPreIntegrationBoundary.source: parent integration run, only read by this lane

computed_timeout.note: Arithmetic inference from fixed source/raw count; guest returned period/cycle0 not directly captured.

functionalScope.acceptedBytes: reg0 RESETB0 reads/writes, reg3 O_DONE0/BG_O_DONE3 reads only
functionalScope.virtualInputs: Explicit ideal stable reference/target clock; initial RESETB byte0=0 is virtual, not silicon POR; 24000 nominal-cycle completion policy
functionalScope.cpuGuard: Actual committed CPU root XTAL observation, default false
functionalScope.transaction: Real target transfer before synchronous BUSY0; controller clock/route does not drive target timer
functionalScope.retention: Explicit functional policy, no silicon retention guarantee

limits: Owned component harness only; no Cargo/shared build, original ROM execution or benchmark.
Native route request is the observed pre-integration boundary; target RESETB/flag transactions have not executed in that run.
Parent owns committed CPU source observations, Bus/Soc/profile routing and deadline/reset arbitration.
Watchdog earlier/same-cycle reset must be handled before pumping to or beyond that reset; module does not retroactively roll back time.
No numeric OCODE, voltage, physical convergence, eFuse calibration, memory result/IRQ or entropy supplied.
No physical CPU DFS timing claim; scheduler uses nominal240MHz cycles.

ownedClippyDriver.scope: Only the standalone owned module harness; no Cargo/workspace lint claim.

staticChecks.manualPrivacyReview: Only relevant relative paths, public source URLs, hashes, numeric samples and command templates retained.

stdoutRetention.historicalOutputFields: Preserved unchanged; see immutable sourceReceipt and distinct raw/normalized output records
